# Aditya Enterprises (AEM)

Aditya Enterprises (AEM), established in 2008 by Mr. Azad Jain and Aditya Jain (B.Tech, Mechanical Engineering), is an industrial steel fabrication and manufacturing company serving customers across India. We design and fabricate steel structures, stainless steel furniture, storage systems, material handling equipment, machining items and pre-engineered building solutions.

Website: https://adityaaem.in
Phone: +91 62329 90925
Email: aditya602jain@gmail.com
Location: 18-B, Sector-D, Industrial Area, Mandideep, MP 462046

Product categories include:
- Plasma coating (rollers, sleeves, plates, machine parts)
- Rubber coating and re-rubberising of rollers
- Heavy steel fabrication and sheet metal work
- Stainless steel industrial and lab furniture
- Material handling equipment
- Industrial storage racks and mezzanine floors
- Pallets, bins and trolleys
- Steel office furniture
- Pre-engineered buildings (PEB)
- Machining items and lathe work (CNC/lathe machined plates, housings, pulleys, gears, PTFE and nylon parts)
- Tool cabinets
- Polycarbonate and acrylic sheet products
- Teflon (PTFE) hose separators
- Silicone rubber suction cups
- Industrial repair and welding services
- Shredding machines and conveyors
